categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four main business segments: structural mechanical performance testing and analysis systems, structural safety online monitoring and defense equipment PHM (Prognostics and Health Management) systems, AI-based intelligent equipment maintenance management platforms, and electrochemical workstations. Additionally, it is developing customized measurement and control analysis systems and experimental and simulation integrated analysis platforms to expand its product portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include intelligent sensing, anti-interference testing, mechanical model optimization algorithms, FPGA/DSP-based real-time control systems, and digital signal processing. The company emphasizes modular design, high-precision sensors, wireless data transmission (e.g., ZigBee), and advanced software platforms. Production employs flexible agile manufacturing supported by MES systems, strict quality control, and comprehensive testing for environmental adaptability and electromagnetic compatibility.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national defense, aerospace, high-speed rail, engineering machinery, bridge and infrastructure construction, energy, mining, chemical, automotive, and scientific research institutions such as universities and research centers. The company serves both industrial and academic markets, focusing on high-end scientific instruments and intelligent monitoring solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in regions including Southwest, Beijing, East China, Northwest, Central China, Shanghai, Central Plains, South China, Southeast, Northeast, and North China. It has subsidiaries and offices in Jiangsu, Shanghai, Sichuan, and other provinces, supporting nationwide coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of testing instruments, sensors, and software solutions. It provides integrated testing systems and value-added services directly to end customers, including system integration and after-sales support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core technologies in intelligent sensing, anti-interference testing, AI, and digital twin technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D (12.22% of revenue in 2024), focusing on expanding product lines, improving reliability and standardization, and developing new platforms such as customized measurement and control systems and experimental-simulation fusion analysis. It also emphasizes talent development and industry collaboration to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of testing instruments, sensors, and software platforms. The company also earns income from providing customized solutions, technical services, and after-sales support. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales channels, supplemented by agency sales, with contracts based on product delivery and service agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in structural mechanical testing and electrochemical workstations, competing against international firms like NI (National Instruments), Siemens, and HBK. It leverages localized product adaptation, competitive pricing, and comprehensive service to gain market share. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise, holding numerous patents and industry awards, positioning it as a technology leader in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 502.2 million, a 32.79% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 121.9 million, up 38.9%. Total assets reached RMB 843.8 million, with net assets of RMB 753.4 million. The company shows strong growth momentum, supported by increased R&D investment and expanding market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, stability, and precision of its sensors and testing systems, suitable for harsh environments. Its products integrate advanced technologies such as wireless data transmission, real-time processing, and AI-driven diagnostics. The company offers comprehensive, customizable solutions with strong after-sales technical support and calibration services, differentiating itself through domestic innovation, cost-effectiveness, and responsiveness to customer needs.
